title: The regular part of every fiber is a k-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold
statement: Let N, m, k ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ an (m+k)-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold, U ⊆ ℝᴺ open with M ⊆ U, and f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on U. Assume (i) for every C¹ Simon local representation (V, W, ψ) of M with ψ : ℝ^{m+k} → ℝᴺ and every x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x); and (ii) x ↦ coareaJacobian M f x is continuous on M. Then for every y ∈ ℝᵐ, (M ∩ f⁻¹{y}) \ {x : coareaJacobian M f x = 0} is a k-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold of ℝᴺ (IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝᵏ) 1; vacuously if it is empty).
lean_statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → (∀ (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → ContinuousOn (coareaJacobian M f) M → ∀ y : Rn m, Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn k) 1 ((M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) \ {x | coareaJacobian M f x = 0})
